newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed to build part of Mobile system - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed to build part of Mobile system - WSJ.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp has agreed to build the ground parts of a satellite-telephone system being proposed by Mobile Communications Holdings Inc, the Wall Street Journal said in Tuesday's electronic edition.

Mobile Communications have valued initial contracts for ground-based operations at around $200 million, the newspaper said. According to the officials, Lockheed would help arrange some financing for its work on the ground operations, the Journal said. It also cited a Lockheed filing with the U.S. Federal Communications Commission.
Lockheed was not immediately available for comment.
